BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: orbital shot
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: The Kwazaari bombard a location of your choice from orbit.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: food delivery
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: 500 packaged survival meals, delivered in Kwazaari drop pods.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: skill trainers
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: Three neurotrainers for a skill of your choice.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: medicine
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: 50 industrial medicine, delivered in Kwazaari drop pods.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: crafting materials
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: 500 steel, 100 plasteel, 50 components and 10 advanced components.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: building materials
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: 1000 stone blocks of your choice and 1000 wood.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: militia squad
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: Two militiamen, with two skirmishers if the melee weapons are installed. A Kwazaari shuttle drops them off under your command for 12 hours. Another shuttle then comes to take them back. Each soldier who does not board it costs 3 scrip, even if that puts you in debt.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: police squad
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: Two police officers, with two riot police if the melee weapons are installed. A Kwazaari shuttle drops them off under your command for 12 hours. Another shuttle then comes to take them back. Each soldier who does not board it costs 4 scrip, even if that puts you in debt.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: reinforcements
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: A field officer, a guard, a breacher and, if the melee weapons are installed, a blademaster. A Kwazaari shuttle drops them off under your command for 12 hours. Another shuttle then comes to take them back. Each soldier who does not board it costs 6 scrip, even if that puts you in debt.

BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: elite squad
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: Two elite troopers, an elite marksman and an elite heavy. A Kwazaari shuttle drops them off under your command for 12 hours. Another shuttle then comes to take them back. Each soldier who does not board it costs 9 scrip, even if that puts you in debt.
